evidence: Historical 2026-11-03 B1/32K 96-step dual-rank kernel times joined to new real B3 module/FX mapping. New four-window exports unavailable during experiment-host connectivity loss.
formula: N_decode * historical_B1_kernel_ms / 1000 / replay_wall. 2x scenario halves the pool, with zero added quantization/layout/launch overhead.
assumptions: Kernel cost is constant over batches 1..4 and contexts; unvalidated.
No savings counted for pure Prefill or mixed steps; quantization may also affect those phases, so this is not a whole-implementation ceiling.
Removed busy time need not reduce wall time equally with frozen external arrivals.
Cross-rank values averaged as a statistic, never summed.
